summary: 200 OK · 20B markdown · stealthy · this call makes 1 extra direct request to the target before the browser runs: a liveness probe (direct, 3s, no retries, no synthetic headers, no redirect hop). Your service's own log will show that one next to the browser's navigation - it is dhole dialing, not the page. · the target is loopback/private, so the browser tier navigated without dhole's invented google referer. What that browser sends of its own (UA, `sec-ch-ua*`, `sec-fetch-*`) arrived as it always does, plus every header you named · 1 of 1 actions did not take effect (wait_selector '#nope-forever': the selector matched no element (or none became actionable) before the timeout: Locator.wait_for: Timeout 10000ms exceed)
next_action: these interactions never happened, so the content is the page BEFORE them - check each failed selector against a fresh copy of the page and retry just that action (metadata.actions lists one row per action)
